baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of أَوْلَىٰ at word indices 2 and 4, with ثُمَّ before the first and فَ before the second.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root supplies both adjacency and uninterrupted succession; repetition turns the formula into two advancing beats in which a threatening matter comes close and is immediately followed by another approach.

activation_trace.role: Nearness without an interval makes the warning an approach to the addressee rather than only an exclamation.
Continuous succession gives the doubled wording its step-after-step temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A duplicated warning formula addressed to you.
changed_reading.after: A warning staged as something drawing immediately nearer to you, then nearer again.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَوْلَىٰ is repeated around the dative لَكَ, making the addressee the explicit recipient.
baseline_models.mechanism: Priority or superior right combines with the directing of good or evil to someone: the phrase can function as a verdict that a consequence is especially fitting for, and assigned to, this addressee.

activation_trace.role: Priority and superior entitlement supply the judgment that something is most fitting or due.
Assigning good or evil to a recipient makes لَكَ the destination of the adjudged consequence.

changed_reading.after: A personalized adjudication: what is due and fitting is directed to you, emphatically twice.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated و ل ي forms and the second-person لَكَ create a compact relation between direction and addressee.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root inventory preserves opposite relational motions, facing toward and turning away. Without context the formula can carry a latent pivot: withdrawal from a relation may be answered by a relation turning back toward the withdrawer.

activation_trace.role: Turning toward and facing supplies the inward direction of the latent pivot.
Turning away and refusing compliance supplies the opposed outward direction.

changed_reading.before: Two equivalent tokens with no directional contrast.
changed_reading.after: A compressed relational reversal in which turning away can make an answering consequence turn toward you.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled أَوْلَىٰ targets لَكَ and is internally advanced by فَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Successive movement combines with reaching a goal or taking possession. The second beat can therefore complete the first: approach does not remain pending but arrives at and overtakes its target.

activation_trace.role: One thing following another supplies the movement from first warning to second.
Attaining a goal or taking possession turns approach into completed overtaking.

changed_reading.before: A threat that may remain rhetorically near.
changed_reading.after: A two-stage threat whose approach culminates in reaching and taking hold of its addressee.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening challenge supplies an agent able to regather dispersed bodily material and restore even fine bodily form. That capacity turns terminal overtaking in the focus from a bare malediction into an executable prospect.

activation_trace.role: Reaching the goal or taking possession supplies the focus threat's terminal force.
Gathering scattered parts supplies the bodily reversal that the threat can actually perform.
Effective capability supplies the power linking warning to realization.
Integral straightening and completion sharpen the claim from rough reassembly to exact restoration.

structural_cues: 75:3 poses non-reassembly as the human calculation; 75:4 immediately negates it with ability.
The bodily detail of fingertips makes the asserted capacity fine-grained rather than generic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, effective ability, and exact bodily completion. I infer that demonstrated resurrection power is the means by which the focus threat can overtake its target; alternatively, the opening proof may support resurrection generally without specifying the focus formula's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A rhetorically forceful but unspecified threat of being overtaken.
changed_reading.after: A threat backed by the demonstrated capacity to reconstruct the addressee and bring the announced end about.

context_deltas.mechanism: Escape is sought, refuge is denied, sovereign ownership is named, and the endpoint is fixed. These removals of distance and alternatives make the focus nearness a closed spatial-legal route rather than a vague emotional threat.

activation_trace.role: Adjacency without a gap supplies the closing distance around the addressee.
Attainment supplies arrival at the endpoint once alternatives are removed.
Flight supplies the attempted counter-motion away from what approaches.
Refuge supplies the possible shelter that the verse explicitly removes.
Sovereign ownership identifies whose domain contains the endpoint.
Fixity and settlement supply the non-negotiable terminus of the movement.

structural_cues: The question 'where is escape?' is followed by categorical denial of refuge and then a destination phrase.
The second-person رَبِّكَ anticipates the second-person لَكَ of the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted flight, no refuge, sovereign destination, and settlement. I infer a route that closes until the focus warning reaches the person; alternatively, these verses may describe destination while the focus remains an independent denunciation.

changed_reading.after: Every exit and shelter is removed, so the warning closes the remaining route and reaches a fixed sovereign endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: What the person advanced and postponed is disclosed, inward sight authenticates the record, and offered excuses fail to displace it. The focus verdict is therefore due to this particular person's temporally complete and self-witnessed record.

activation_trace.role: Superior right or fitness supplies the verdict that the outcome is deserved.
Assigning good or evil supplies the direction of that verdict to لَكَ.
Advancing something ahead supplies the forward portion of the person's record.
Deferral to a later time supplies the record's postponed portion.
Inward insight makes the addressee an evidentiary witness against evasion.
Excuse and exculpation supply the attempted defense that cannot erase the self-known record.

structural_cues: 75:13 covers both what was sent ahead and what was delayed.
75:14-15 contrast self-insight with the casting of excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a complete temporal record, self-insight, and excuses. I infer that these facts ground the focus phrase's judgment of fitness and assignment; alternatively, the record scene may establish accountability without determining the lexical force of أَوْلَىٰ.

changed_reading.before: An impersonal declaration that a bad outcome is due.
changed_reading.after: A person-specific sentence fitted to a complete record the addressee already recognizes despite excuses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person gives affective and temporal priority to what comes quickly while abandoning what comes later. The focus reverses that ordering: the deferred realm becomes the matter now nearest to, and most pressingly due for, the addressee.

activation_trace.role: Immediate proximity reverses the attempt to keep the later realm distant.
Priority and superior claim answer the addressee's mistaken ordering of priorities.
Heart-attached love supplies the motive that fixes the person on the immediate.
Haste and bringing forward supply the preferred temporal pole.
Leaving something behind supplies the act meant to keep the other pole remote.
Lateness names the deferred realm whose apparent distance is overturned.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 form an explicit يحبون/تذرون and العاجلة/الآخرة antithesis.
The focus's repeated proximity language occurs after the realm called later has been abandoned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies love of the immediate and abandonment of the later. I infer an ironic temporal reversal in which the deferred future becomes nearest and gains priority; alternatively, أَوْلَىٰ may express only doom without answering the earlier priority vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: The formula says only that doom is close or fitting.
changed_reading.after: It overturns the addressee's temporal preference: what was loved for being immediate loses priority, while what was left for later is now nearest and due.

context_deltas.mechanism: Arrival at a bodily limit, recognized separation, the wrapping of limb with limb, and compulsory driving form a sequence of narrowing thresholds. The focus's two beats become the cadence of an approach already moving through the body toward its final destination.

activation_trace.role: Continuous succession organizes the death signs as one threshold following another.
Reaching the goal gives the sequence its terminal arrival.
Reaching a limit supplies the first explicit threshold in the bodily corridor.
Separation between two things supplies the irreversible break recognized at death.
One thing wrapping onto another supplies the bodily constriction immediately before removal.
Sovereign ownership identifies the destination toward which the person is moved.
Driving and urging supply compulsory motion through the last threshold.

structural_cues: 75:26-30 advances by short clauses from bodily arrival to separation, entanglement, and driving.
Repeated ثُمَّ and فَ in the surrounding sequence make the focus's own connectors part of a broader staged cadence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive bodily thresholds and a drive toward the Lord. I infer that this sequence is the concrete route enacted by the focus's successive approach; alternatively, it may merely precede the denunciation as narrative background.

changed_reading.after: A bodily death cadence: limit, separation, constriction, and compulsory conveyance make the warning arrive stage by stage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failure to confirm is answered by denial, and the same و ل ي root first marks the person's turning away before it marks what is fitting and near for him. The focus becomes a root-level rebound: his withdrawal returns as an assigned consequence directed back to him.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies the answering motion back toward the person who withdrew.
Fitness or due entitlement turns the rebound into recompense rather than mere motion.
Directing evil to a recipient makes لَكَ the endpoint of the rebound.
Realizing truth in deed supplies the action explicitly negated before the rebound.
Contradiction of truth supplies the positive rejection paired with failed confirmation.
Turning away and refusing compliance supplies the initiating motion that the focus reverses.

structural_cues: 75:31-32 pairs two negated responses with two contrary acts, ending on تَوَلَّىٰ.
The focus follows after only one intervening verse and reuses the same root in أَوْلَىٰ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected confirmation, denial, and same-root turning away immediately before the focus. I infer a retaliatory directional arrow from withdrawal to consequence returning upon the withdrawer; alternatively, the repeated root may be wordplay without a causal reversal.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a warning adjacent to a list of misconduct.
changed_reading.after: It is the conduct's root-shaped rebound: the one who turned away has a fitting consequence turn close and be assigned back to him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical two-token formula already occurs in 75:34, then ثُمَّ launches it again in 75:35. Internal فَ and external ثُمَّ create a four-token ratchet, making succession itself the warning's dominant architecture.

activation_trace.role: Succession organizes the two focus tokens as consecutive beats.
Repeated adjacency makes each beat register as a further closing of distance.
The preceding identical pair extends the focus's succession from two beats to four.

structural_cues: 75:34 is exactly أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ, while 75:35 repeats it after ثُمَّ.
Four occurrences of the same root are grouped as two ف-linked pairs joined by ثُمَّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact adjacent duplication and explicit sequencing particles. I infer a staged ratchet in which each recurrence intensifies proximity; alternatively, the fourfold pattern may be rhetorical intensification without distinct stages.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains a self-contained double warning.
changed_reading.after: It is the second half of a four-beat ratchet whose repeated succession progressively closes on the addressee.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus questions deny that the human is released without purpose, trace the person through determined formation, and end with effective power over renewed life. This activates the focus root's authority and entitlement branches: the formula can voice a creator's rightful claim over a creature who is not abandoned to self-disposal.

activation_trace.role: Assuming charge and authority supplies the jurisdictional relation over the addressee.
Superior right supplies the claim that accountable disposal is fitting rather than arbitrary.
Releasing and leaving supplies the condition that the question explicitly contests.
Determination and enactment of a measure supply purposeful ordering at the person's origin.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the basis of the claimed authority.
Effective capability supplies continuing power over the creature beyond first formation.

structural_cues: 75:36 immediately follows the doubled formula with a question about being left سُدًى.
75:37-40 runs from origin through formation to the capacity to revive the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied release, determined origin, creation, and continuing power. I infer that these establish a rightful relation of authority activated by the focus root; alternatively, the closing questions may justify resurrection while أَوْلَىٰ remains solely a threat formula.

changed_reading.before: A deserved threat with no stated basis of jurisdiction.
changed_reading.after: A creator's claim of rightful charge over a deliberately formed creature who will not be released without account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form does not ordinarily name rain; it remains packet-anchored through the focus root's branch for a later rain following an earlier one, reinforced by context branches for water and rain-given life. Carry it only as a branch-image analogy for successive animation, never as a lexical translation of أَوْلَىٰ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two focus occurrences of و ل ي activate B010, whose image is a later rain following the wasmi rain, while repetition already marks succession.

activation_trace.role: A later rain following an earlier one supplies an ecological image of a second life-giving event in sequence.
Water ranging from a drop upward supplies the first formation's minimal fluid beginning.
Land revived by rain makes later watering a material analogy for renewed life.
Dead land or lifeless matter completes the rain-to-revival analogy at the surah's final question.

changed_reading.before: The repetition carries only escalating menace.
changed_reading.after: At the level of branch imagery, the second beat faintly resembles a later watering after the first: renewed animation follows initial formation as a second event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because أَوْلَىٰ is not an explicit statement that someone is an ally or guardian. It remains anchored in the focus's و ل ي alliance and authority branches, the denied refuge, and the named sovereign endpoint; downstream prose should present it as a relational undertone, not as the phrase's direct sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dative لَكَ and repeated و ل ي permit the root's alliance and authority relations to color what is now attached to the addressee.

activation_trace.role: Loyal alliance and support supply the protective relation whose availability is put in question.
Authority and charge supply the sovereign relation that remains when alternatives collapse.
Refuge names the protective alternative explicitly denied.
Sovereign ownership identifies the authority to which the addressee finally belongs.

changed_reading.before: The phrase assigns an isolated threat to the individual.
changed_reading.after: It also carries a faint foreclosure of patronage: no protective relation remains outside the immediate claim of sovereign authority.

strongest_changes: The adjacent occurrence in 75:34 changes the focus from a double warning into the second half of a four-beat succession.
تَوَلَّىٰ in 75:32 makes the focus a same-root rebound in which turning away is answered by a fitting consequence turning close.
Love of the immediate and abandonment of the later in 75:20-21 make أَوْلَىٰ reverse the addressee's own ordering of nearness and priority.
The death corridor and the denial of escape give the formula a concrete route: thresholds close, refuge disappears, and compulsory movement reaches a fixed endpoint.
The record and creation frames make the outcome both personally deserved and backed by effective authority.
summary.what_was_special: The focus has only one repeated root, but the whole-surah packet activates several mechanisms without requiring a single final choice: spatial nearness, temporal succession, deserved allocation, directional rebound, terminal attainment, and sovereign claim. Exact same-root reuse immediately before the focus is especially productive.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which the priority/entitlement branch is lexical here rather than a branch-level coloring remains uncertain.
The directional rebound from تَوَلَّىٰ may be deliberate same-root wordplay or only contextual resonance.
The authority and patronage readings are coherent but more form-distant than nearness, succession, and deservedness.
The later-rain activation should remain an explicitly speculative material analogy rather than enter an unqualified rendering.
